sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Adds Save to device and Share file to the menu of downloaded songs. Saves songs to Music/Audiomack as Artist - Title, with their tags and cover art. Requires Android 10 or later.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Unlocks Plus features. Region-limited songs are still restricted.
